name: Ghost Notes from the Paste Server
description: A hacker collective's paste archive has resurfaced on the lab network after a midnight migration. Find the reachable service, recover credentials you can use, and retrieve the protected dispatch flag. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

tasks.name: Recover the dispatch
tasks.description: On the lab network, locate the collective's reachable service, find usable credentials, and recover the protected dispatch flag. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: Start with the listening services and their access behavior; one may let you in without a password.
Try PostgreSQL access from the lab network, then inspect what the low-friction account can read for account details.
Use the discovered operator credentials to reconnect, then read the protected dispatch record.
